Try itNumbers in the code, or parameters

The heading controller has four numbers in its code, and each changes with the job. try it

In the codeValue
Target90°
Gain1.5
Speed limit1.0 rad/s
Tolerance0.02 rad
  1. Another target. Turning to 180° instead of 90° means editing the .cpp and building again.
  2. Tuning. A good gain is found by trying values: later in this section, a gain of 0.5 takes 6.4 s for a 90° turn, and 1.5 takes 2.7 s. With constants, every try is edit, build, run.
  3. Another robot or world. GP2 runs the same controller against the stand-in robot and in Gazebo, tuned for each: params_stand_in.yaml and params_gazebo.yaml.
Values that change with the task, the robot or the world belong outside the code: in parameters, which you set when the node starts or while it runs.
